Description

Dataset for the published communications paper of the same title in Journal of Power Sources Advances (doi:10.1016/j.powera.2020.100036)
Data consists of fuel cell performance data, GC-methaniser data, SIFT-MS data, and calculated CO adsorbed data. 
The data can be found all on 1 page in a .csv format or .xlsx format with separate sheets for each data group.
